beats.say: Albert Einstein redefined gravity in 1915, but the idea started in 628 CE.
Brahmagupta proposed the concept of gravity in 628 CE, long before modern physics.
Gravity is a fundamental interaction that draws material objects towards each other.
It gives weight to physical objects and drives surface water waves and lunar tides.
Einstein described gravity as the curvature of spacetime caused by mass distribution.
The most extreme example is a black hole, where nothing, not even light, can escape.
Gravity has an infinite range, but its effects weaken as objects get farther away.

facts: Brahmagupta proposed the idea of gravity in 628 CE.
Gravity is a fundamental interaction that draws material objects towards each other.
Gravity gives weight to physical objects and is essential for surface water waves, lunar tides and weather patterns.
Albert Einstein proposed the general theory of relativity in 1915.
General theory of relativity describes gravity as curvature of spacetime caused by uneven distribution of mass.
The most extreme example of spacetime curvature is a black hole from which nothing, not even light, can escape.
Gravity has an infinite range but its effects become weaker as objects get farther away.
